character_sheet.name: Ong Tu
character_sheet.description: Ong lao ngoai luc tu, 60-70 tuoi, da sam nang, khuon mat khac kho, mac ao ba ba den bac mau, khan ran co, chan tran

scenes.label: Hook – dem song Hau
scenes.prompt_vi: Nha ba gian ngoi ta reu phong, cau khi be sang tung to go muc, song Hau mo suong khoi, anh trang vang vo qua tan la, den dau hot vit leo let sau khung cua so, suong trang tron tren mat nuoc, canh dong que mien Tay truoc 1975, phong cach hinh anh tai lieu dan gian mau vang den xanh trang mo
scenes.prompt_en: Weathered Vietnamese three-bay tiled house (nha ba gian ngoi ta), mossy roof, rustic bamboo monkey bridge over dark Mekong river at night, pale moonlight filtering through palm leaves, single oil lamp (den dau hot vit) flickering in a window, thin white mist drifting on still water, 1960s rural South Vietnam atmosphere, documentary realism, muted palette: oil-lamp amber, pale moonlight blue-green, white mist, deep shadow — cinematic 9:16 vertical
scenes.motion: slow camera push forward from river bank toward house, mist drifting left
scenes.voiceover: Dem do, nuoc song Hau rut can… chi con tieng keo gio duoi ben.

scenes.label: Ong Tu keo luoi
scenes.prompt_vi: Ong lao mac ao ba ba den keo luoi tren cau khi hep, lung tre nen sau, dem toi chi co anh den dau yen oi, tay ram rao keo day luoi, mat song den nhanh, phong cach phim tai lieu Viet Nam 1970s, khung doc 9:16
scenes.prompt_en: Elderly Vietnamese man wearing worn black ba-ba shirt, pulling fishing net on a narrow bamboo monkey bridge over dark river at night, dense bamboo grove silhouette behind him, only oil-lamp light from far shore, rough weathered hands gripping rope, dark fast-moving Mekong water below, 1970s Vietnamese documentary film style, vertical 9:16 cinematic, shallow depth of field, film grain
scenes.motion: slow handheld tilt down from man's face to hands to water surface

scenes.label: Ban tay trang duoi nuoc
scenes.prompt_vi: Canh gan: ban tay trang nhat, ngon tay thon dai, bam vao mep luoi tu duoi nuoc den bat dau trai len, anh sang xanh lanh phat ra tu duoi mat nuoc song toi, khong the nhin ro khuon mat, chi thay ban tay trang vuon len, nuoc den loi, phong cach kinh di dan gian Viet Nam, khung doc
scenes.prompt_en: Extreme close-up: an unnaturally pale white hand with slender fingers gripping the edge of a fishing net from beneath dark river water, cold bluish-green light emanating from under the surface, dark murky water, no face visible, only the ghostly hand reaching upward, Vietnamese folk horror aesthetic, vertical 9:16, desaturated except cold blue-green accent, film grain, slow motion feel
scenes.motion: slow zoom out revealing more of the net, hand tightening grip
sfx: trong com don dap thap len

scenes.label: Giong ma – den dau chao
scenes.prompt_vi: Bong nguoi trang nhat lut qua cau khi trong suong, den dau hot vit treo o cot chao manh bat chot, bong toi lam dau, song nuoc den lay lanh, khong ro mat, chi thay anh sang chao loa, suong day, phong cach kinh di tam ly, mau toi am, khung doc 9:16
scenes.prompt_en: Ghostly pale silhouette gliding across bamboo monkey bridge in heavy night mist, oil lamp (den dau hot vit) on a post swinging violently casting wild shadows, surrounding darkness amplified, dark river water shimmering below, face completely obscured, only flickering lamp light and swirling white mist, psychological horror, South Vietnamese folk ghost aesthetic, dark moody palette — vertical 9:16 cinematic
scenes.motion: slow rack focus from lamp to silhouette to darkness
scenes.vo_effect: pitch shift -3 semitone, reverb large hall, pan L-R slow oscillation

scenes.label: Ket mo – ga gay binh minh
scenes.prompt_vi: Binh minh le ta tren dong que mien Tay, suong tan dan, anh sang vang nhat xuat hien, cau khi trong vang khong nguoi, nha ba gian ngoi ta phia xa, ga gay, nhan AIGC goc duoi phai, phong cach phim tai lieu yeu binh, trang thai mo giua thuc va mo, khung doc 9:16
scenes.prompt_en: Pre-dawn light slowly creeping over rural Mekong Delta landscape, mist lifting, pale golden light emerging on horizon, empty bamboo monkey bridge in foreground, three-bay tiled Vietnamese house (nha ba gian) in far background, serene yet eerie stillness, AIGC watermark bottom-right corner, documentary peaceful aesthetic, ambiguous boundary between dream and reality — vertical 9:16, warm-cold color contrast
scenes.motion: very slow pull back revealing wider landscape as dawn breaks
